# Extended analysis (generated by scripts/analyze_extended.py)

95% percentile bootstrap intervals over test minimal pairs (B = 2000), one shared resampling matrix, so all differences are paired. Fine-tuned groups: mean over seeds, cluster bootstrap (all seeds of a pair are resampled together). Sections marked *exploratory* were not preregistered.

## 1. Preregistered hypotheses: decision rules applied

### H1: flip-pair accuracy at least 10 points below item accuracy (off-the-shelf models)

Gap = item accuracy on flip pairs − flip-pair accuracy. Decision: supported if the lower bound of the 95% interval of (gap − 0.10) is above 0.

| System | Item acc. (flip pairs) | Flip-pair acc. | Gap | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| zeroshot_nli-deberta-v3-xsmall | 0.472 [0.452, 0.491] | 0.129 [0.107, 0.153] | 0.343 [0.327, 0.359] | supported |
| zeroshot_nli-deberta-v3-base | 0.612 [0.595, 0.628] | 0.263 [0.233, 0.293] | 0.349 [0.333, 0.365] | supported |
| zeroshot_DeBERTa-v3-base-mnli-fever-anli | 0.623 [0.603, 0.642] | 0.304 [0.272, 0.337] | 0.319 [0.303, 0.335] | supported |
| zeroshot_roberta-large-mnli | 0.426 [0.408, 0.444] | 0.070 [0.053, 0.088] | 0.356 [0.340, 0.371] | supported |

Note: the gap is largest for a model that ignores the edit (it cannot exceed item accuracy, and a constant prediction has flip-pair accuracy 0), so H1 is a necessary rather than a demanding condition; Section 5 decomposes the failures.

### H2: exception and boundary edits below negation

Difference = flip-pair accuracy(operator) − flip-pair accuracy(negation). Supported for an operator if the upper bound is below 0; H2 is supported for a system if it holds for all four operators.

### H4: shift from dev (vehicles) to test families, and to reserved templates

Dev and test are independent samples (independent bootstraps). Reserved vs. seen templates is computed within test, raw and stratified by operator (mean of per-operator differences weighted by pair count), because reserved templates are not spread evenly over operators.

| Group | Dev acc. | Test acc. | Dev − test | Seen − reserved (raw) | Seen − reserved (operator-stratified) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| ft_nli-deberta-v3-xsmall_paired | 0.834 | 0.900 | -0.066 [-0.092, -0.041] | +0.051 [+0.030, +0.072] | +0.047 [+0.027, +0.067] |
| ft_nli-deberta-v3-xsmall_unpaired | 0.845 | 0.892 | -0.047 [-0.075, -0.021] | +0.037 [+0.013, +0.059] | +0.032 [+0.008, +0.054] |

Reserved-template pairs in test: 924 of 1280.

### H5: hypothesis-only flip-pair accuracy ≤ 0.05

Flip-pair accuracy 0.000 [0.000, 0.000]: **supported**. This holds by construction (both sides share the hypothesis and have different labels, so any deterministic hypothesis-only classifier scores 0); it is a sanity check, not an empirical finding. The informative shortcut measure is item accuracy: 0.415 [0.398, 0.432] vs. majority 0.390 [0.371, 0.408].

## 7. Evidence sensitivity (exploratory)

Preregistered occlusion hit@1 (sentence whose removal most lowers p(gold) is in the gold evidence set; 300 correctly answered entailed/contradicted test items) next to two reference points: the hit rate of a random sentence, and a strict variant that ignores the obligation sentence (which belongs to every decided item's evidence set).

| System | hit@1 | Random-sentence hit rate | Top sentence = obligation | Strict hit@1 (non-obligation evidence) | Random, strict |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| ft_nli-deberta-v3-xsmall_paired_s0 | 1.000 [1.000, 1.000] | 0.489 | 0.907 | 0.126 [0.086, 0.171] (n=222) | 0.279 |
| ft_nli-deberta-v3-xsmall_paired_s1 | 0.993 [0.983, 1.000] | 0.509 | 0.873 | 0.159 [0.115, 0.207] (n=227) | 0.295 |
| ft_nli-deberta-v3-xsmall_unpaired_s0 | 1.000 [1.000, 1.000] | 0.502 | 0.940 | 0.084 [0.051, 0.121] (n=214) | 0.307 |
| ft_nli-deberta-v3-xsmall_unpaired_s1 | 0.997 [0.990, 1.000] | 0.502 | 0.930 | 0.089 [0.053, 0.129] (n=225) | 0.283 |

**Counterfactual removal test.** For each sampled item and each sentence, the expected label after deleting that sentence is derived from the rule specification (`clauseshift.evidence`, validated against the generator on 706 pairs). Removals are grouped as: the obligation sentence (expected: insufficient), a *decisive* condition (expected: the label changes), and a *non-decisive* sentence (expected: unchanged). Items with a cross-reference are excluded: removal variants drop the article headers, so "Article k" cannot be resolved. The header-free full document (no sentence removed) is the format control.

| System | Items | Header-free control correct | Obligation removed → insufficient | Decisive removed → label changes as expected | Non-decisive removed → label kept |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| ft_nli-deberta-v3-xsmall_paired_s0 | 272 | 0.915 | 0.982 (n=272) | 0.800 (n=90) | 0.904 (n=679) |
| ft_nli-deberta-v3-xsmall_paired_s1 | 273 | 0.960 | 0.956 (n=273) | 0.879 (n=99) | 0.920 (n=662) |
| ft_nli-deberta-v3-xsmall_unpaired_s0 | 269 | 0.985 | 0.989 (n=269) | 0.877 (n=73) | 0.948 (n=670) |
| ft_nli-deberta-v3-xsmall_unpaired_s1 | 273 | 0.949 | 0.996 (n=273) | 0.824 (n=102) | 0.918 (n=646) |
